get_stat_compute_statistics: get statistics including length, min, max, and mean from a numpy array or torch tensor
get_stat_torch_tensor_stats: compute min, max, and mean statistics from a PyTorch tensor converted to numpy
print_corrs_summary: print a summary of correlation scores across layers and nodes with optional detail output
print_corrs_detailed: print detailed correlation scores per layer and node including s_score, s_idx, and min_rank
print_corrs_active_nodes: print correlation summary filtered to only active nodes per layer using the active_nodes parameter
